mission_09: Mutual Information (MI) measures the dependency between features and the target variable, capturing both linear and non-linear relationships. Unlike the F-test which only detects linear relationships, MI can identify complex patterns like quadratic or sinusoidal dependencies. This makes MI particularly powerful for feature selection when you suspect non-linear relationships exist. In this mission, you will calculate MI scores for all features, rank them, select the top features, and compare MI-based selection with the F-test approach to see how MI captures non-linear informative features that the F-test might miss.
